title: Stop the miner
briefing: You've found the rogue miner. Shut it down.
One legitimate process sits nearby — don't hit the wrong one.
tips: `kill PID` stops a process. Read before you strike.
objective: Stop the rogue cryptominer process (leave the backup-agent running).
hints: Find the miner's PID with `ps aux`, then stop it by PID.
`kill <pid of cryptominer>`. Do NOT kill backup-agent.
`ps aux` shows cryptominer at PID 6666: `kill 6666`  (or `pkill cryptominer`)

reactions.say: That was the backup agent, not the miner! Read the command column before you kill.

explanation: `kill PID` sends SIGTERM (a polite 'please stop'). `pkill NAME` kills by command name when you don't want to hunt for the PID. You may only kill your own processes unless you're root.
